unit.can_do_en: pick up a parcel and spell my name.

brief.situation_en: A courier, Mikael, knocks on Maria's door.

lines.speaker: Mikael
lines.text_puhe: Moi! Onks tää Leena Virtasen asunto?
lines.text_kirja: Hei! Onko tämä Leena Virtasen asunto?
lines.gloss_en: Hi! Is this Leena Virtanen's flat?

judge.reason: Moi/hei and onks/onko are register differences; same question about Leena Virtanen's apartment.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.gloss_en: No, she lives in the flat next door.

judge.reason: Spoken 'se' refers to a person, equal to written 'hän'; same meaning.

lines.speaker: Mikael
lines.text_puhe: Se ei oo kotona. Voitsä ottaa paketin?
lines.text_kirja: Hän ei ole kotona. Voitko sinä ottaa paketin?
lines.gloss_en: She's not home. Could you take the parcel?

judge.reason: Joo and kyllä both mean yes; same reply.
Kiitti/kiitos and sun nimi/sinun nimesi are register variants; same request to write your name.
Okei/selvä and onks/onko are register differences; same question about whether it is heavy.

lines.speaker: Mikael
lines.gloss_en: A little. There are books in it.

judge.reason: Siin/siinä is a dropped ending; same statement that there are books in it.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.text_puhe: Ei hätää. Mä annan sen Leenalle illal.
lines.text_kirja: Ei hätää. Minä annan sen Leenalle illalla.
lines.gloss_en: No worries. I'll give it to Leena this evening.

judge.reason: Mä/minä and illal/illalla are register differences; same promise to give it to Leena in the evening.

forms.form_name_en: present tense, 3rd person singular, with the question ending -ko/-kö
forms.why_en: Means 'is...?'. The question ending -ko turns 'on' (is) into a question.
This is the dictionary form. People say it the same way.

forms.form_name_en: present tense, 2nd person singular, with the question ending -ko/-kö

forms.why_en: This is the dictionary form. People say it the same way.
Yes. In everyday speech people often say joo instead.

Thank you, said by the customer; in casual speech it becomes kiitti.

forms.why_en: 'It.' Nominative singular, referring back to the price.
